what_happened: Premise re-validation found the declared must-land-first territory edge (328) already completed and archived (commit fd86bf491), so the plan needs no deferral and the task is unblocked -- a blocked round avoided by checking live state rather than trusting the dispatch's recorded edge.

validate-artifact.sh --strict cross-checks each phase's Tier Justification against suite_selection_select's real output; it mechanically caught six justifications that were fabricated or under-verifying (including one claiming a suite for paths the selector maps to __FULL_SWEEP__), which were corrected to the verbatim selection before the plan shipped.

The dispatch's candidate containment option (1) named agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/test-harness-lib.sh as the place to extend; that file does not exist (no *harness*/*test* file in scripts/lib at all), and it is also present in the task's declared file_scope in state.json with no file behind it. The plan reaches option (1)'s outcome by reordering the one call site instead of creating the speculated library.

Design collision surfaced during planning: the detector's scope includes scripts/tests/, so the detector's own new suite would trip it if its positive fixture is written as a literal source line beginning with the guard. Resolved in-plan by requiring the fixture line to be assembled from pieces plus a negative-control case, rather than by a path exclusion the dispatch explicitly forbids.
